status: Existing provisional source adaptation, not an established original WTL dependency and not an exact-match claim.
adaptations: Use the observed MBCS CRT character/conversion APIs instead of later WTL helpers.
Apply string precision before minimum width, as in the original instructions.

origin_limit: Distinctive scanner structure supports Microsoft CString lineage. Whether the game copied source, adapted it independently, or included an earlier header is unresolved.
